what: The research columns on the every-tick table: the natural gas exhaustion and dipole lines and the information measure at every tick, each move on the tick of its first step, each hump on the tick it began on
asked: Greg, 2026-11-23: "Put the research columns on the every tick tables. Yes we want every tick ... Just update what already exists"
nothing_rewritten: These are new column files lined up row for row with the stored rows, as every calculation's columns are. No stored file is changed. Nothing new is calculated on the tape; no window, no label, no average, no midpoint; nothing from another trade day.

columns.what: The tick: its position on the tape, as on the stored row.
THE EXHAUSTION LINE at this tick: bought minus sold over bought plus sold, the trades of the last 20 seconds; the stored line read by place on the tape. Above zero buying, below selling.
THE DIPOLE LINE at this tick: the same figure over the last 60 seconds, read the same way.

THE INFORMATION MEASURE at this tick (not the dipole, not the exhaustion). THE INFORMATION RATIO (the operator's C_signed): the mean of the entropy of the twenty bought pieces and the entropy of the twenty sold pieces, over the information the two lists share, signed by the side that leads. HUGE WHERE info_ratio_made_by_division IS TRUE: do not read its size there.
THE INFORMATION MEASURE at this tick (not the dipole, not the exhaustion). Codex's form of the ratio: its sign times the logarithm of one plus its size.

THE INFORMATION MEASURE at this tick (not the dipole, not the exhaustion). The information the twenty bought pieces and the twenty sold pieces share (the bottom of the ratio). Zero where all the trading of the 20 seconds is on one side.
THE INFORMATION MEASURE at this tick (not the dipole, not the exhaustion). The operator's ent_dipole: the entropy of the bought pieces minus the entropy of the sold pieces, over their sum.

THE INFORMATION MEASURE at this tick (not the dipole, not the exhaustion). The operator's mi_flow: the shared information of the later ten pieces minus that of the earlier ten, signed by the side that leads.

THE INFORMATION MEASURE at this tick (not the dipole, not the exhaustion). The operator's imb_flow: bought minus sold over bought plus sold of the later ten seconds, minus the same of the earlier ten.

THE INFORMATION MEASURE at this tick (not the dipole, not the exhaustion). How many of the twenty one-second pieces hold any trade with a side. A figure standing on one or two pieces stands on very little.

TRUE where the two lists share exactly nothing (all the trading of the 20 seconds is on one side): there the ratio is a number over the operator's smallest number, made by the division and not by the market. FALSE otherwise. Empty where nothing with a side traded.
